test_name: MT202 Interbank Transfer UK to Japan
description: Interbank transfer from HSBC UK to Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp Japan. This demonstrates a typical FI-to-FI payment using name & address options (D) for some fields.
test_coverage: Field 52D - Ordering Institution with Name & Address (D option)
Field 57A - Account With Institution with IBAN account
Field 58D - Beneficiary Institution with account and Name & Address
Field 72 - Sender to Receiver Info with structured codes
Mixed field options (A and D) in single message
business_rules_expected_to_pass: Proper multi-line format for D option fields

transfer_details.from_institution: HSBCGB2L - HSBC Bank PLC, London UK
transfer_details.to_institution: SMBCJPJT - Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp, Tokyo Japan

notes: This MT202 uses the D (Name & Address) option for fields 52 and 58, demonstrating flexibility in party identification. Field 57A includes an IBAN account number for the nostro/vostro account that HSBC holds with Sumitomo Mitsui. Field 58D includes the final beneficiary institution account number and full name/address. Field 72 contains instructions (/INS/) and references (/REF/) to the underlying customer payment that this MT202 is covering. The related reference (21) indicates this is a cover payment for a customer payment.
